text: Cracking your knuckles gives you arthritis.
explanation: Research has not found evidence that habitual knuckle cracking causes osteoarthritis. Multiple studies found no significant association between knuckle cracking and hand arthritis.
source: Journal of the American Board of Family Medicine

es.text: Crujirse los nudillos te da artritis.
es.explanation: La investigación no ha encontrado evidencia de que el crujido habitual de los nudillos cause artrosis. Varios estudios no encontraron una asociación significativa entre crujir los nudillos y la artritis en las manos.

explanation: The flu is caused by a virus. CDC states that antibiotics treat bacterial infections and do not work against viruses like influenza.

es.explanation: La gripe es causada por un virus. Los CDC dicen que los antibióticos tratan infecciones bacterianas y no funcionan contra virus como la influenza.

text: Washing your hands with soap helps prevent illness.
explanation: CDC states that handwashing with soap removes germs and helps prevent respiratory and diarrheal illnesses.

es.text: Lavarse las manos con jabón ayuda a prevenir enfermedades.
es.explanation: El CDC dice que lavarse las manos con jabón elimina los gérmenes y ayuda a prevenir enfermedades respiratorias y diarreas.

explanation: CDC reports that many studies have found no link between vaccines and autism spectrum disorder.

es.explanation: Los CDC informan que muchos estudios no han encontrado relación entre las vacunas y el trastorno del espectro autista.

text: Smoking increases the risk of lung cancer.
explanation: The CDC identifies cigarette smoking as the leading cause of lung cancer and lung cancer deaths.

es.text: Fumar aumenta el riesgo de cáncer de pulmón.
es.explanation: Los CDC identifican fumar cigarrillos como la principal causa de cáncer de pulmón y de muertes por cáncer de pulmón.

text: Humans only use 10% of their brains.
explanation: Brain imaging studies show that people use many parts of the brain throughout the day; the 10% claim is a myth.
source: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke (NIH)

explanation: WHO states that regular physical activity reduces the risk of heart disease, diabetes, and some cancers while improving mental health.

text: You should wait 24 hours before reporting a missing person.
explanation: Law enforcement agencies state there is no mandatory waiting period before reporting a missing person.
The NIH notes that water is essential for body functions and maintaining hydration.
source: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases

explanation: Research reviewed by NIH and other health organizations has not shown that sugar causes hyperactivity in most children.

text: Seat belts reduce the risk of serious injury in car crashes.
explanation: Seat belts save lives and reduce serious crash-related injuries by keeping occupants securely positioned.

text: Cold weather alone causes the common cold.
explanation: Colds are caused by viruses, not simply by being exposed to cold temperatures.

text: Getting enough sleep is important for health.
explanation: CDC states that sufficient sleep supports physical health, mental health, and cognitive performance.
Research has not established chocolate itself as a direct cause of acne.

text: Sunscreen helps protect against skin cancer.
explanation: The FDA and CDC recommend sunscreen use because it helps protect skin from harmful UV radiation that can contribute to skin cancer.
